intent: Build truthful equipment, conference, and yacht-event discovery pages for Esteban Moreno Media

visual_evidence.scope_reason: Reuse existing service page composition; no new visual scene or motion is in scope.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Keep brand identity and verify actual mobile visibility and breathing room.
visual_evidence.comparison: Existing videographer and corporate-event service pages before and after factual discovery expansion.

brief.visitor: South Florida business or event organiser deciding whether to hire on-location filming and editing.
brief.promise: Understand the relevant shoot service, what the current equipment means in practice, and what to send for a useful quote.
brief.primary_action: Start a qualified project inquiry with date, location, duration and deliverables.
brief.friction: The current yacht page only describes editing supplied footage and the current camera information is absent.

kpi.decision_rule: Keep or improve routes only when they gain qualified inquiry or evidence of discovery; otherwise consolidate.

concept.idea: Use calm, evidence-first service pages rather than a gear catalogue.
concept.brand_reason: Esteban’s established cream and terracotta editorial service composition already explains a project clearly.
concept.interaction: Visitor can read the first answer and send the project essentials without opening optional detail.
concept.visible_response: Existing inquiry route pre-fills the selected service.
concept.direct_path: Inquiry remains visible before optional reading.
concept.alternatives: No animation, equipment photo, or technical specification claims without verified owner assets and facts.

story.opening: State the specific filming service and service area.
story.action: Visitor compares on-location filming with editing supplied footage.
story.consequence: They know whether their conference or yacht dinner belongs in the new service and what facts to provide.

content.visible: Answer-first offer, service scope, full-day conference planning, truthful camera ownership context.
content.optional_html: Native details for preparation questions only.
content.linked_depth: Existing videographer, corporate-event, yacht-editing and editor-vs-videographer pages.

references.borrow: Existing GeoServicePage/service-depth patterns and branded tokens.
references.avoid: Thin equipment spec pages, invented claims, and client work represented before permission.

components.reuse: GeoServicePage, ServiceAnswerFirst, ServiceDeepDive, ServiceFaqs, existing inquiry links.
components.local_reason: Copy/data additions only; no new shared visual component needed.

verification.accessibility_performance: Existing project checks plus headings, tap targets and contrast spot-check.
verification.raw_html: curl built routes and assert answer-first/schema/details text.
verification.conversion_boundary: Verify existing inquiry links and analytics event semantics without sending a lead.
